warnings: Six steel-truss connection details referenced from the TRUSS T1 elevation (S-08). None carries a member mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (spec §0.2); member sizes kept verbatim.

Detail 1 (slotted top plate) and detail 2 (round holes) are the two column-head seats on the RC columns; detail 3 seats the truss on the steel corridor posts on row C. This sheet names the bottom chord 'ขื่อเหล็ก ⊥ 50x50x3.2มม' — the same section the S-08 elevation labels 'เหล็ก ⊥ 50x50x3.2มม'.
